About the Bike Party Sacramento group ride

A big themed social ride on the first Friday of the month, rain or shine. Hundreds show up with lights, costumes and sound systems. Volunteers plan the route and theme; there are no official leaders, and you ride at your own risk. Start point changes each month and is posted on Facebook and Instagram.
